account.preferences.display.title: Display preferences
account.preferences.notifications.title: Notifications
account.mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
account.mfa.description: Add a second step to sign-in: a code from an authenticator app on your phone, on top of your password or social login.
account.mfa.recoveryCodesNoneLeft: None left, you cannot sign in without your app
account.mfa.recoveryCodesRemaining: {count, plural, one {# unused code} other {# unused codes}} to sign in without your app

account.mfa.setupStartFailed: Could not start the setup, try again
account.mfa.savedRecoveryCodes: I have saved my recovery codes

account.mfa.disableModal.description: Sign-in will no longer ask for a code, and your recovery codes stop working. Confirm it is you first.
account.mfa.enableModal.doneDescription: From now on, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.

account.mfa.recoveryCodesList.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard, select the codes and copy them by hand
account.mfa.recoveryCodesList.saveNowTit: Save these codes now, they are shown only once
account.mfa.recoveryCodesList.saveNowDes: Each code signs you in once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them in a password manager or print them. Any codes you had before are no longer valid.
account.mfa.regenerateModal.doneDescript: The previous codes no longer work.
account.mfa.regenerateModal.title: Regenerate recovery codes
account.mfa.regenerateModal.description: You will get 10 new single-use codes and the current ones stop working. Confirm it is you first.
